parts.text: dance for fun

This recreational dance workshop provides an accessible, high-energy environment focused on movement, physical wellness, and stress relief. Participants will engage in a guided warm-up, learn beginner-friendly choreography set to popular music, and practice basic rhythm and coordination exercises. Designed for all skill levels, the session emphasizes self-expression and casual enjoyment over formal technical precision, concluding with a light group cool-down and stretching segment.

The ACM Hackathon is an intensive, collaborative event where participants work individually or in small teams to design, build, and deploy creative software projects. Throughout the session, attendees engage in hands-on programming, rapid prototyping, and technical problem-solving to develop functional applications ranging from web and mobile platforms to data-driven tools. The event concludes with project demonstrations, where participants present their completed software solutions to a panel of judges.
